purpose: Illustrative real Session replay screenshots; not a tracking accuracy benchmark

source.creator: Lukas Kosc
source.presentation_scope: Three selected-frame documentation works combined with actual application UI, tracking boxes/IDs and explanation; not standalone original-video redistribution
source.rights_notice: Underlying footage retains Pexels terms, not AGPL; no affiliation or endorsement implied; third-party rights remain applicable

execution.depth_units: relative; per-frame virtual 1..5 display mapping, not metres
execution.preparation: Existing real V2Adapter.predict/prepare_cloud/bundle_bytes/SessionStore.capture helpers in a clean local runtime copy
execution.runtime_scope: Reused local CUDA environment; not a fresh installation of complete Alpha.2 requirements (which specify a newer torch/torchvision pair)
execution.worker_settings: Original defaults, no ReID; one fixed step per saved frame
execution.browser: Actual localhost HTTP Session UI, zh-TW; seek 1/12/24 and play to end; unretouched viewport crops

observed_counts.interpretation: Unassociated is not ground-truth FN; no identity GT, IDSW/IDF1/HOTA or accuracy score

limits: Only 0.959 seconds and partial occlusion/crossing, not long-occlusion acceptance
Local ID stability does not establish correct identity; missing/new observations not a confirmed ID switch
Source FPS, fixed worker time step and UI playback rate differ
Relative depth/HFOV estimates are not metric accuracy or world trajectories
No fresh complete-install, Windows, physical RTSP, endurance or hardware-WebGL acceptance
Published tags/assets and historical MOT studies unchanged

included: Source attribution, hashes, settings and aggregate evidence
excluded: Private images, credentials, runtime logs or host paths
